scenes.text: Quick test. Is this A-I, or just automation? Most owners mix them up.
A text goes out every time someone books. A-I, or automation?
Automation. Same rule, every time. No thinking needed.
Reading a customer's message, and drafting a reply in plain English?
That's A-I. It handles the messy, unpredictable part.
So which do you need? Usually automation first. A-I helps with the messy parts, once the basics run on their own.
Rules for the routine. A-I for the messy. People for the decisions. Follow for more.
